author: SisuGirl
body: I've been told you use them in the hub, but I can't figure out how. All I see is cosmetics, but I'm not sure how to buy other stuff, like kits.

title: How do I use credits ingame?

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
With credits, you are able to purchase items from the cosmetics shop, which is located in the hub (the gold nugget).



Once buying your item, they will be sent to your backpack (the ender chest) where you can enable/disable certain items, discard them as well as just looking through what you have.



Regarding crates, they are distributed randomly at the end of each match. You are able to open a crate by obtaining a key, which can be purchased at the shop. In the future, there may be more uses for credits and more ways to obtain keys other than buying them, but for now, this is all.
